name: winui
description: Drive a Windows desktop app by its controls (UI Automation): list windows and controls, click, type, read, wait. Finds controls by name or automation id instead of guessing screen coordinates. Windows or WSL.
usage: winui windows | tree <window> | click <window> <control> | type <window> <control> <text> | read <window> <control> | wait <window> [control] | focus <window>
